m: एर् (आ-√ ईर्), Caus. P. Ā. -ईरयति, -ते (pf. 3. pl. एरिरे and एरिरे) to bring near, cause to obtain, procure, RV.; AV.; VS.; to procure for one's self, obtain, RV. i, 6, 4; iii, 60, 3; to raise (as the voice in singing), RV. iii, 29, 15; x, 122, 2.

a: एरंडः — The castor-oil plant; (a small tree with a scanty number of leaves); and hence the proverb: निरस्तपादपे देशे एरंडोपि द्रुमायते. --डा Long pepper. --Comp. --पत्रिका, --फला the plant Croton Polyandrum (दंतीवृक्ष).
